versions.changelog:
- Updated the skill documentation from Chinese to English to improve accessibility.
- Modernized trigger keywords in the description to use English terms.
- Added a LICENSE file.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

- Added comprehensive guidance on planning and reviewing frontend testing strategy, emphasizing risk-based test layer selection and coverage mapping.
- Clearly defined purpose, step-by-step procedure, constraints, and expected outputs for building an effective layered testing strategy.
- Outlined test layers, including static checks, unit, component, lightweight integration, E2E, visual regression, a11y, security, and performance.
- Provided practical advice for managing test data, flaky risks, and maintaining reasonable test coverage without unnecessary tooling changes.
- Included detailed requirements to ensure actionable, risk-addressed, and maintainable testing plans.
